definitions.explanation: Casual or dialectal contraction of {知|し}らない (shiranai), meaning "I don't know." Common in western Japanese dialects and casual male speech.
Used to dismiss responsibility or express indifference, often with an abrupt or blunt tone.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧こと{知|し}らん。
⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧{知|し}らん⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: I have no idea where that guy is.

examples.japanese: ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{知|し}らん⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦たぶん→たぶん：00815_tabun⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧だろう。
examples.english: I don't know when it'll arrive, but probably next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{知|し}らん。{勝手|かって}に⟦しろ→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I don't care anymore. Do whatever you want.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{知|し}らんぞ。
examples.english: Don't blame me if you fail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ことだろう。⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{知|し}らん⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧な。
examples.english: You decided this yourself. I'm not responsible for whatever happens.

notes:
USAGE:
{知|し}らん is a contraction of ⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧. It is characteristic of casual male speech and western Japanese dialects (especially Kansai). In standard Japanese, it sounds blunt or rough.

COMMON PATTERNS:
The ん ending is a contraction of ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ that appears in many verbs in casual speech: ⟦{分|わ}からん→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧), ⟦{食|た}べん→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (⟦{食|た}べない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧), etc. This pattern is especially common in western dialects.

REGISTER:
More casual and blunt than ⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧. Using {知|し}らん with strangers or superiors would sound rude.
